detail.longDescription: I have sent probably four hundred emails in my life that just said some version of "does 2pm Thursday work for you?" Calendly exists so none of us has to do that anymore. Invitees see your real availability and pick a slot without the back and forth. That solves the booking problem. It doesn't solve everything else that comes with a new meeting, like syncing it to your team's calendar or logging the invitee in your CRM.
